It includes an onboard generator, an industrial air compressor, an arc welder, and an extensive suite of pneumatic and hand tools. It enables wheeled vehicle mechanics (MOS 91B) to diagnose, service, and repair disabled vehicles directly on the battlefield.

NAME: AN/PSN-13 Defense Advanced GPS Receiver (DAGR)
DESCRIPTION: This is a handheld, dual-frequency military satellite navigation receiver that tracks encrypted military P(Y)-code GPS signals. It provides dismounted soldiers and vehicular platforms with precise position, speed, and timing information resistant to enemy electronic jamming and spoofing. The unit can be integrated with tactical radios, laser rangefinders, and command computers to transmit instant situational reports.

NAME: Unit Armorer Small Arms Tool Kit
DESCRIPTION: This is a standardized tool set issued to unit armorers to conduct organizational-level maintenance on assigned small arms. It includes specialized cleaning rods, armorer's multi-tools, alignment gages, pin punches, and screwdrivers tailored for M4 carbines, M17 pistols, and M240 machine guns. The kit ensures weapons remain functional and compliant with technical manuals at the company level.

NAME: M1076 Palletized Load System Trailer (PLST)
DESCRIPTION: This is a three-axle tactical trailer engineered to carry standard 8x20 foot flatracks or 20-foot ISO shipping containers with a payload capacity of 16.5 tons. It is towed behind M1074 or M1075 Palletized Load System (PLS) trucks, effectively doubling the cargo capacity of a single vehicle and crew. The trailer features a self-steering rear axle and air suspension to maintain stability and maneuverability over rough cross-country terrain.

NAME: AN/PRC-117G Multiband Manpack Radio
DESCRIPTION: This is an advanced tactical software-defined manpack radio covering high-frequency (HF), very-high-frequency (VHF), and ultra-high-frequency (UHF) bands from 30 MHz to 2 GHz. It provides secure Type 1 encrypted line-of-sight voice, dedicated tactical satellite communications (TACSAT), and high-speed Mobile User Objective System (MUOS) mobile data. Powered by rechargeable lithium-ion batteries, it is widely utilized by infantry, special operations, and forward air controllers.

NAME: Shop Equipment, Welding Field Repair
DESCRIPTION: This is a complete mobile welding and metal-cutting equipment set mounted on a heavy-duty trailer or packaged in modular containers. It includes a multi-process engine-driven welder/generator, oxyacetylene cutting torches, safety gear, and specialized electrodes for welding high-strength steel and aluminum armor. It allows field mechanics to perform critical structural and battle-damage repairs directly on combat platforms.

NAME: Special Sniper Rifle Equipment and Accessory Kit
DESCRIPTION: This is an operational equipment and maintenance kit tailored to support precision sniper weapon systems such as the M110 Semi-Automatic Sniper System or M2010 Enhanced Sniper Rifle. It contains precision optical cleaning gear, bore guides, specialized torque wrenches, anti-reflection devices, and night-vision optical couplers. The kit ensures sniper teams can maintain match-grade accuracy and weapon readiness under expeditionary field conditions.

NAME: M915A5 Line-Haul Truck Tractor
DESCRIPTION: This is a commercial-derivative 6x4 heavy tactical truck tractor designed to pull semitrailers such as the M872 34-ton flatbed and M967 fuel tankers over highway and primary road networks. Powered by an inline 6-cylinder turbocharged diesel engine generating over 500 horsepower, it can haul gross combination weights up to 120,000 pounds. The modern A5 model features an armored cab option (B-kit), enhanced suspension, and advanced vehicle stability control.

NAME: Shop Equipment, Guided Missile Maintenance
DESCRIPTION: This is a specialized mobile maintenance shop set containing diagnostic test consoles, optical collimators, and armorer tools for servicing anti-tank guided missile systems (such as TOW and Javelin). It allows technicians to verify missile launcher electronics, sight sensor alignments, and fire control interfaces. The set is packaged in ruggedized shipping containers for tactical deployment.

NAME: M1151A1 Armament Carrier HMMWV
DESCRIPTION: This is an expanded-capacity 4x4 light tactical vehicle configured with Integrated Armor Protection (IAP) to protect the crew against small arms, artillery shrapnel, and blast hazards. It features a reinforced roof weapon station equipped with an armored gunner shield to mount weapon systems including the M2A1 .50 cal, MK19 grenade launcher, or M240B machine gun. It carries a four-soldier combat crew plus ammunition and gear over challenging cross-country terrain.

NAME: M500 12-Gauge Shotgun
DESCRIPTION: This is a pump-action tactical 12-gauge shotgun manufactured by Mossberg, featuring an 18.5-inch barrel, a 5-round tubular magazine, and an ambidextrous safety switch. It is employed by military police, security elements, and infantry for close-quarters room clearing, security operations, and mechanical door breaching using specialized frangible rounds. The weapon fires standard 2-3/4 inch and 3-inch shotshells, including buckshot, solid slugs, and non-lethal munitions.

NAME: TS-3895A/UV Night Vision Test Set
DESCRIPTION: This is an optical and electrical test station designed to test, focus, calibrate, and evaluate Aviator's Night Vision Imaging Systems (such as AN/AVS-6 and AN/AVS-9). It incorporates high-precision optical collimators and calibrated light targets to verify binocular alignment, infinity focus, and image intensifier tube resolution. It is used in aviation life support and electronics maintenance shops to guarantee pilot safety.

NAME: AN/USM-491 Radio Frequency Test Set
DESCRIPTION: This is a comprehensive radio frequency test and alignment station used by depot and direct support electronic repair facilities. It provides calibrated RF signal generation, spectrum analysis, and power measurement across military communication and radar bands. The unit is utilized to align complex communications transceivers and microwave radio repeaters.

NAME: M1089A1 5-Ton Wrecker Truck
DESCRIPTION: This is a 6x6 tactical wrecker vehicle built on the Family of Medium Tactical Vehicles (FMTV) chassis, designed to perform vehicle recovery and towing missions. It is equipped with a 5-ton capacity hydraulic recovery crane, twin 11,000-pound recovery winches, and an underlift towing system capable of lifting and towing disabled trucks. It allows recovery teams to upright overturned vehicles and tow them to forward maintenance points.

NAME: M1101 1-1/4 Ton High Mobility Cargo Trailer
DESCRIPTION: This is a single-axle, all-aluminum light cargo trailer designed to be towed behind HMMWVs and other light tactical vehicles over all terrain types. It has a payload rating of 2,500 pounds and shares the same track width, ground clearance, and run-flat tires as its prime mover to ensure off-road mobility. The trailer features a weather-resistant cargo cover and a tailgate for easy manual loading.

NAME: M250 Machine Gun
DESCRIPTION: The M250 is a 6.8mm lightweight machine gun designed to replace the M240 and M249 in close combat units. It offers increased lethality, range, and lighter weight, utilizing 6.8x51mm hybrid ammunition.

NAME: M2A2 Aiming Circle
DESCRIPTION: The M2A2 Aiming Circle is an optical instrument used to measure azimuth and elevation angles. It is critical for accurately orienting indirect fire weapon systems like mortars and artillery pieces.

NAME: AN/PRS-9 Battlefield Anti-Intrusion System
DESCRIPTION: The AN/PRS-9 is an unattended ground sensor system used to detect enemy movement and intrusions. It provides early warning to small units by transmitting seismic and acoustic sensor data back to a monitoring receiver.

NAME: AN/PRC-155 Manpack Radio
DESCRIPTION: The AN/PRC-155 is a two-channel manpack radio that provides secure voice and data communications. It connects tactical users to the Warfighter Information Network-Tactical (WIN-T) and operates across multiple waveforms.

NAME: AN/PRC-154 Rifleman Radio
DESCRIPTION: The AN/PRC-154 Rifleman Radio is a lightweight, body-worn radio that provides secure voice and data networking for dismounted Soldiers. It operates using the Soldier Radio Waveform (SRW) to share location information and tactical voice communications.

NAME: General Tactical Computer Set
DESCRIPTION: This is a ruggedized military computer system used for tactical operations and command and control. It processes and displays battlefield data, enabling commanders to track friendly and enemy forces and plan missions.

NAME: Inflatable Tactical Shelter
DESCRIPTION: This is an inflatable tent system used to quickly establish command posts, medical facilities, or billeting areas. It uses an air-supported frame for rapid deployment and strike, providing environmentally controlled work areas for troops.

NAME: AN/GYK-33D Advanced Field Artillery Tactical Data System
DESCRIPTION: The AN/GYK-33D AFATDS is a fire support command and control system. It automates the planning, execution, and coordination of artillery, mortar, and naval gunfire support, processing fire missions and providing firing data.

NAME: M98A2 Javelin Command Launch Unit
DESCRIPTION: The M98A2 CLU is the reusable targeting and control portion of the Javelin anti-tank missile system. It features multiple thermal and day imaging modes used to acquire targets and guide the missile before launch, and can also be used as a standalone surveillance optic.

NAME: AN/PSG-14 Digital Data Set
DESCRIPTION: This digital data set is a portable tactical device used by forward observers to transmit digital fire support requests. It communicates target coordinates and firing data securely over military tactical radios to coordinate artillery strikes.

NAME: M7 Spider Networked Munitions System
DESCRIPTION: The M7 Spider is a remotely controlled, networked anti-personnel munition system. It replaces traditional landmines by allowing a human operator to control its detonation, providing perimeter defense while preventing unintended civilian casualties.

NAME: AN/PSS-14 Mine Detecting Set
DESCRIPTION: The AN/PSS-14 is a hand-held mine detector that combines ground-penetrating radar and a highly sensitive metal detector. It allows combat engineers and explosive ordnance disposal units to find both metallic and non-metallic landmines and improvised explosive devices.

NAME: M7 Smoke Grenade Discharger
DESCRIPTION: The M7 Smoke Grenade Discharger is a multi-tube launcher mounted on tactical vehicles to fire smoke grenades. It creates an instant visual and infrared smoke screen to conceal the vehicle from enemy targeting systems and visual observation.

NAME: AN/VAS-5 Driver's Vision Enhancer
DESCRIPTION: The AN/VAS-5 is a thermal imaging system designed for drivers of military vehicles. It provides the driver with enhanced situational awareness and the ability to drive safely in total darkness, fog, and battlefield smoke.

NAME: Tactical Software System
DESCRIPTION: This line item covers various tactical software packages used in Army command and control, intelligence, and fire support systems. Because this is a generic software LIN, its exact function depends on the hardware it is loaded onto, but it universally enables digital battlefield management.

NAME: AN/PVS-14 Monocular Night Vision Device
DESCRIPTION: The AN/PVS-14 is a helmet-mounted or hand-held night vision monocular widely issued to Soldiers. It amplifies ambient light to allow the user to see in low-light conditions for movement, navigation, and engaging targets.

NAME: M2 Lensatic Compass
DESCRIPTION: The M2 Lensatic Compass is a standard-issue magnetic compass used for land navigation and orientation. It features sighting wires and a magnifying lens to allow precise azimuth readings for map reading and dismounted movement.

NAME: M150 Mortar Fire Control System
DESCRIPTION: The M150 is a computerized fire control system used with infantry mortar systems. It calculates ballistic data, allowing mortar crews to rapidly and accurately aim their weapons without needing manual aiming stakes or optical sights.

NAME: M152 Remote Control Demolition Firing Device
DESCRIPTION: This kit contains the necessary blasting machines and electrical components used by engineers to initiate explosive charges. It allows for the safe and reliable detonation of demolitions for breaching, clearing obstacles, and destroying captured equipment.

NAME: Hydraulic Hoist Unit
DESCRIPTION: This is a hydraulic lifting device often integrated into maintenance vehicles or recovery equipment. It allows mechanics and recovery personnel to safely lift heavy vehicle components like engines and transmissions during field repairs.

NAME: M1278 Heavy Guns Carrier
DESCRIPTION: The M1278 is the Heavy Guns Carrier variant of the Joint Light Tactical Vehicle (JLTV) family. It provides protected mobility for its crew and is equipped with a turret designed to mount heavy crew-served weapons like the .50 caliber machine gun or Mk 19 grenade launcher.

NAME: AN/PEQ-15 Advanced Target Pointer Illuminator Aiming Light
DESCRIPTION: The AN/PEQ-15 is a weapon-mounted laser device that emits visible and infrared lasers, as well as an infrared illuminator. It is used in conjunction with night vision goggles to aim weapons and mark targets in low-light or nighttime conditions.

NAME: AN/PPX-3(B) Interrogator Set
DESCRIPTION: The AN/PPX-3(B) is a tactical Identification Friend or Foe (IFF) interrogator used primarily with air defense systems. It transmits signals to aircraft and processes the replies to distinguish friendly aircraft from unknown or enemy contacts, preventing friendly fire.

NAME: Tactical Motion Lighting Kit
DESCRIPTION: This kit provides motion-activated lighting for tactical field operations, command posts, and perimeter security. It helps to illuminate specific areas upon detecting movement, aiding in physical security and lowering power consumption compared to continuous lighting.

NAME: Target Locator Module
DESCRIPTION: The Target Locator Module is an advanced optical targeting device used by forward observers to accurately determine enemy coordinates. It integrates a laser rangefinder, compass, and GPS to generate precise grid coordinates for calling in artillery or air support.

NAME: M252A1 81mm Mortar System
DESCRIPTION: The M252A1 is a medium-weight, smoothbore, muzzle-loaded 81mm mortar weapon system used by infantry battalions. It provides organic indirect high-angle fire support, delivering high explosive, illumination, and smoke rounds at ranges up to nearly 6,000 meters.

NAME: Mk 22 Advanced Sniper Rifle
DESCRIPTION: The Mk 22 is a modular, multi-caliber bolt-action sniper rifle system replacing legacy sniper rifles. It can be easily reconfigured in the field to fire 7.62x51mm, .300 Norma Magnum, or .338 Norma Magnum ammunition depending on the mission requirements.

NAME: M32A1 Lightweight Handheld Mortar Ballistic Computer
DESCRIPTION: The M32A1 is a ruggedized handheld computer used by mortar squads to quickly and accurately calculate firing data. It replaces manual firing tables by instantly determining elevation and deflection adjustments based on target coordinates and environmental factors.

NAME: M153 Common Remotely Operated Weapon Station
DESCRIPTION: The M153 CROWS is a computerized fire control system and weapon mount that allows vehicle crews to operate crew-served weapons from inside the armored hull. It integrates sensors, rangefinders, and ballistic computers to significantly increase first-round hit probability.

NAME: M224A1 60mm Mortar
DESCRIPTION: The M224A1 is a lightweight, smoothbore, muzzle-loaded 60mm mortar used primarily by infantry companies for close-in indirect fire support. It can be fired in both a conventional drop-fire mode from a bipod or a handheld trigger-fire mode.

NAME: M120A1 120mm Towed Mortar System
DESCRIPTION: The M120A1 is a heavy, towed 120mm mortar system that provides high-angle, indirect fire support for infantry and armor units. It fires heavy high-explosive, smoke, and illumination rounds at extended ranges, significantly bridging the gap between medium mortars and artillery.

NAME: M240B Machine Gun
DESCRIPTION: The M240B is a 7.62x51mm belt-fed, gas-operated medium machine gun used widely by infantry and vehicle crews. It is renowned for its reliability and is used to provide sustained, high-volume suppressive fire against enemy personnel and unarmored targets.

NAME: AN/PSQ-20 Enhanced Night Vision Goggle
DESCRIPTION: The AN/PSQ-20 is a helmet-mounted night vision device that overlays a thermal image on top of a traditional image intensification (night vision) picture. This fusion provides Soldiers with unparalleled target detection capabilities in zero-light or obscured environments.

NAME: M19 Plotting Board
DESCRIPTION: The M19 Plotting Board is a manual, analog tool used by artillery and mortar fire direction centers to chart target locations and calculate firing data. Although largely replaced by digital computers, it remains a critical backup system for fire direction when electronic systems fail.

NAME: AN/PED-1 Lightweight Laser Designator Rangefinder
DESCRIPTION: The AN/PED-1 LLDR is an advanced target acquisition device used by forward observers. It determines target range, elevation, and azimuth, and can laser-designate targets to guide precision-guided munitions dropped by aircraft or fired by artillery.

NAME: M110A1 Squad Designated Marksman Rifle
DESCRIPTION: The M110A1 is a 7.62x51mm semi-automatic rifle designed to engage targets at ranges beyond the capability of the standard 5.56mm service rifle. It provides infantry squads with organic precision fire capabilities to defeat body armor and targets in defilade up to 600 meters away.

NAME: M3E1 Multi-Role Anti-Armor Anti-Personnel Weapon System
DESCRIPTION: The M3E1 is an 84mm reusable, shoulder-fired recoilless rifle used by infantry units to defeat armored vehicles, bunkers, and personnel. It features a titanium and carbon fiber construction to reduce weight and can fire a wide variety of specialized ammunition types.

NAME: M7 Assault Rifle
DESCRIPTION: The M7 is a 6.8mm assault rifle chosen to replace the M4A1 Carbine in close combat forces. It fires a high-pressure 6.8x51mm hybrid cartridge designed to defeat modern body armor at extended ranges while utilizing advanced fire control optics.

NAME: Global Broadcast System Receive Suite
DESCRIPTION: This satellite receive suite is used to download high-volume data, such as full-motion video, imagery, and intelligence products, directly to tactical command posts. It provides commanders with high-bandwidth, one-way broadband data reception via satellite.

NAME: M110 Semi-Automatic Sniper System
DESCRIPTION: The M110 is a 7.62x51mm semi-automatic sniper rifle that provides rapid, precision fire on multiple targets. It is highly effective in urban combat environments where a bolt-action rifle may be too slow, and features a quick-attach sound suppressor.

NAME: AN/PRC-152 Multiband Handheld Radio
DESCRIPTION: The AN/PRC-152 is a secure, software-defined handheld tactical radio used extensively by dismounted troops. It provides line-of-sight and satellite communications across multiple frequency bands, ensuring interoperability between ground forces and aircraft.

NAME: AN/VRC-91F SINCGARS Vehicular Radio Set
DESCRIPTION: The AN/VRC-91F is a vehicle-mounted dual-radio configuration of the Single Channel Ground and Airborne Radio System (SINCGARS). It provides secure, frequency-hopping tactical voice and data communications for mobile units and command posts.

NAME: AN/PRC-119F SINCGARS Manpack Radio
DESCRIPTION: The AN/PRC-119F is a portable, battery-operated manpack version of the SINCGARS radio system. It is carried by radiomen to provide secure, jam-resistant voice and data communications for dismounted infantry patrols and command elements.

NAME: RQ-11B Raven Small Unmanned Aircraft System
DESCRIPTION: The RQ-11B Raven is a hand-launched, small unmanned aircraft system used at the company and battalion level for over-the-hill reconnaissance. It provides real-time color or infrared video imagery directly to ground commanders to increase situational awareness.

NAME: AN/VRQ-1() One System Remote Video Terminal
DESCRIPTION: The OSRVT is a portable system that allows ground forces to receive full-motion video and telemetry data directly from nearby unmanned aircraft systems. This provides real-time aerial reconnaissance feeds directly to squad leaders and commanders on the ground.

NAME: M157 Next Generation Squad Weapon - Fire Control
DESCRIPTION: The M157 is an advanced computerized optical sight designed for the Army's Next Generation Squad Weapons. It integrates a variable magnification optic, laser rangefinder, ballistic calculator, and atmospheric sensors to provide a corrected aiming point for the shooter.

NAME: M151 Spotting Scope
DESCRIPTION: This is a high-magnification optical spotting scope used primarily by sniper teams. The spotter uses it to detect targets at extreme ranges, read wind conditions, and observe bullet trace and impacts to provide corrections to the sniper.

NAME: AN/PVS-29 Clip-On Sniper Night Sight
DESCRIPTION: The AN/PVS-29 is an image intensification night vision device that mounts directly in front of a sniper's existing day scope. It allows the sniper to engage targets in total darkness without needing to remove their primary day optic or re-zero their rifle.

NAME: Guided Missile Handling Trainer
DESCRIPTION: This is an inert training aid used to teach Soldiers how to properly handle, load, and store heavy guided munitions like the Patriot or HIMARS missiles. It mimics the weight, dimensions, and center of gravity of the live weapon without containing any explosive materials.

NAME: Target Acquisition System
DESCRIPTION: This line item covers various electro-optical, thermal, or radar systems used to detect, track, and identify enemy forces. It is essential for gathering intelligence, directing fire support, and providing early warning on the battlefield.

NAME: Target Locator Module
DESCRIPTION: This is a handheld or tripod-mounted electro-optical device that combines a laser rangefinder, compass, and GPS. It is used by forward observers to precisely determine the grid coordinates of enemy targets so they can be engaged with indirect fire.

NAME: M1167 Expanded Capacity TOW Carrier HMMWV
DESCRIPTION: The M1167 is an up-armored variant of the High Mobility Multipurpose Wheeled Vehicle (HMMWV) specifically designed to carry and fire the TOW anti-tank missile system. It features reinforced armor to protect the crew while engaging enemy armor from static positions.

NAME: M45A1 Boresight
DESCRIPTION: The M45A1 is an optical alignment tool used to align a weapon system's sights with its gun barrel. This ensures the weapon is accurately zeroed, which is critical for hitting targets, especially for tank guns and other crew-served weapons.

NAME: Tactical Electric Power Plant
DESCRIPTION: This is a trailered, large-scale mobile diesel generator system used to provide sustained electrical power for large tactical operations centers, field hospitals, or air defense batteries. It ensures critical electronic systems remain operational in austere environments.

NAME: M1165A1 Expanded Capacity Command and Control HMMWV
DESCRIPTION: The M1165A1 is an up-armored utility HMMWV designed primarily to serve as a mobile command and control platform or transport vehicle. It features upgraded suspension and a heavier payload capacity to accommodate additional armor, communications gear, and personnel.

NAME: RQ-20B Puma Small Unmanned Aircraft System
DESCRIPTION: The RQ-20B Puma is a battery-powered, hand-launched tactical drone used for intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance. It offers longer flight times and heavier payloads than the smaller Raven, providing enhanced over-watch capabilities for infantry battalions.

NAME: Portable Medical Ventilator
DESCRIPTION: This is a compact, ruggedized mechanical ventilator used by military medical personnel in field hospitals and during aeromedical evacuation. It provides life-saving respiratory support to critically injured Soldiers suffering from severe trauma or breathing failure.

NAME: AN/PAS-13 Thermal Weapon Sight
DESCRIPTION: The AN/PAS-13 is a family of thermal imaging scopes that can be mounted on individual rifles and crew-served weapons. It allows Soldiers to see the heat signatures of enemy personnel and vehicles through darkness, smoke, fog, and light foliage.

NAME: AN/VRQ-1(V) Multi-Frequency Remote Video Terminal
DESCRIPTION: This tactical terminal system allows ground combat units to receive and view real-time video feeds from various aerial drones and targeting pods. It greatly enhances battlefield situational awareness by letting troops see what the aircraft sees overhead.

NAME: Tactical Battery Charger Kit
DESCRIPTION: This is a rugged, multi-port battery charging station used to recharge various military-grade lithium-ion and alkaline batteries. It ensures that critical electronics, such as tactical radios and night vision devices, have a sustained power supply during extended field operations.

NAME: Commander's Independent Viewer Kit
DESCRIPTION: This kit provides armored vehicle commanders with an independent, fully rotatable thermal viewing optic. It allows the commander to search for and designate new targets independently of the gunner, enabling a highly efficient hunter-killer target engagement process.

NAME: Special Duty Assignment
DESCRIPTION: The 00D code designates a Soldier serving in a special duty assignment rather than their primary occupational specialty. These duties can vary widely and often include assignments outside the standard force structure or specialized short-term tasks.

NAME: Officer Generalist
DESCRIPTION: The 01A concentration indicates an officer serving in a branch-immaterial position that does not require a specific occupational specialty. These officers are responsible for general leadership, staff duties, and organizational management tasks.

NAME: Infantryman
DESCRIPTION: Infantrymen are the core land combat force of the Army, responsible for closing with and destroying the enemy in ground combat. They operate a variety of small arms and crew-served weapons, conduct patrols, and execute tactical offensive and defensive operations.

NAME: Indirect Fire Infantryman
DESCRIPTION: Indirect Fire Infantrymen operate the Army's tactical mortar systems, providing critical indirect high-explosive and illumination fire support. They are responsible for calculating fire data, setting up mortar firing positions, and maintaining the weapons.

NAME: Infantry Senior Sergeant
DESCRIPTION: Infantry Senior Sergeants are the most experienced enlisted leaders in infantry units, typically serving as First Sergeants or Command Sergeants Major. They manage the training, discipline, and administrative needs of their units while advising commanders on tactical operations.

NAME: Electromagnetic Spectrum Manager
DESCRIPTION: Electromagnetic Spectrum Managers manage and deconflict radio frequencies for tactical military communications systems. They ensure that combat units can communicate effectively without electronic interference and work to protect friendly networks from enemy electronic warfare.

NAME: Chemical, Biological, Radiological and Nuclear (CBRN) Officer
DESCRIPTION: CBRN Officers lead specialized units and advise commanders on defense measures against chemical, biological, and nuclear threats. They oversee decontamination operations, threat reconnaissance, and ensure that the force is trained to operate safely in contaminated environments.

NAME: Advanced Combat Parachute Release System (ACPRS) Assembly
DESCRIPTION: The Advanced Combat Parachute Release System (ACPRS) is a safety device used in airborne operations to release the parachute canopy upon landing. It prevents paratroopers from being dragged by high winds once they reach the ground.

NAME: MC-6 Personnel Parachute System
DESCRIPTION: The MC-6 is a static-line deployable steerable personnel parachute system used by airborne forces. It allows paratroopers to safely jump from an aircraft and maneuver to specific drop zones during airborne insertions.

NAME: BA-22 Bailout Parachute System
DESCRIPTION: This is an emergency parachute system designed for aircrew to escape from a disabled aircraft. It is a compact, reliable parachute meant to be deployed quickly in emergency bailout situations to ensure the user safely reaches the ground.

NAME: A-22 Cargo Aerial Delivery Bag
DESCRIPTION: The A-22 is an adjustable canvas and webbing cargo bag used to bundle supplies for airdrop from military aircraft. It can hold up to 2,200 pounds of ammunition, rations, or medical supplies and is typically rigged with a G-14 cargo parachute.

NAME: A-21 Cargo Aerial Delivery Bag
DESCRIPTION: The A-21 is a canvas and webbing cargo bag used to bundle moderately sized supplies and equipment for airdrop from military transport aircraft. It allows logistics units to safely package up to 500 pounds of mission-critical cargo for aerial delivery to ground forces.

NAME: 8-Foot Attitude Control Bar
DESCRIPTION: This is an 8-foot metal stabilizing bar used when rigging large, heavy platforms for airdrop. It helps maintain the platform's balance and orientation as it exits the aircraft and descends, ensuring a safe and stable landing.

NAME: M7 Bayonet with Scabbard
DESCRIPTION: The M7 is a standard bayonet designed to be mounted on the M16 series of rifles. It features a 6.5-inch steel blade and comes with a rigid plastic scabbard, serving as both a close-combat weapon and a versatile field utility knife.

NAME: M25 Binocular
DESCRIPTION: The M25 is a 14x stabilized binocular used by military personnel to observe distant targets and terrain. It features a gyroscopic stabilization system to eliminate hand tremors, providing a clear image even from moving vehicles or aircraft.

NAME: RQ-11B Raven Small Unmanned Aircraft System
DESCRIPTION: This is a small, hand-launched unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) used by tactical units for real-time reconnaissance and surveillance. It carries color and infrared cameras to provide commanders with localized, low-altitude aerial intelligence.

NAME: M256A2 Chemical Agent Detector Kit
DESCRIPTION: The M256A2 is a portable kit used by troops to detect and identify dangerous concentrations of nerve, blister, and blood chemical agents. It uses chemical indicator ampoules and test spots to verify whether an area is safe to unmask.

NAME: AN/TYQ-109 Digital Communications Set
DESCRIPTION: The AN/TYQ-109 is a deployable digital communications node used to route and process military network traffic in the field. It provides secure voice, data, and internet connectivity to command posts and tactical operation centers.

NAME: RT-875 Rough Terrain Crane
DESCRIPTION: This is a heavy-duty, wheel-mounted rough terrain crane used for lifting and moving heavy cargo, construction materials, and vehicle components. It features four-wheel drive and steering, allowing it to maneuver through unimproved terrain on the battlefield.

NAME: 25-Ton Truck-Mounted Crane
DESCRIPTION: This is a commercial-style or militarized truck equipped with a hydraulic crane capable of lifting up to 25 tons. It is utilized by engineer and logistics units for loading heavy cargo, constructing bridges, and performing field recovery operations.

NAME: Secondary Transfer Calibration Set
DESCRIPTION: This is a suite of highly precise electronic and mechanical testing instruments used by maintenance and calibration technicians. It ensures that field-level diagnostic equipment and tools provide accurate measurements, which is critical for repairing modern weapon systems.

NAME: Secondary Transfer Calibration Set
DESCRIPTION: Similar to other secondary calibration sets, this collection of precision instruments is used to calibrate electrical, microwave, and physical testing devices in the field. It allows specialized maintenance units to keep standard Army tools and gauges accurate to factory specifications.

NAME: AN/UDM-2 Radiac Calibration Set
DESCRIPTION: The AN/UDM-2 is a specialized radiological testing device used to calibrate military radiation detectors. It contains precisely measured radioactive sources, allowing technicians to verify that chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear warning equipment is functioning properly.

NAME: Container Handling Unit (CHU)
DESCRIPTION: The Container Handling Unit is an attachment system fitted to tactical load-handling trucks, enabling them to lift and transport standard 20-foot shipping containers without a flatrack. It streamlines logistics by allowing drivers to load and unload heavy containers directly from the cab.

NAME: Chemical Agent Monitor (CAM) Diagnostic Test Set
DESCRIPTION: This test set is used to troubleshoot and verify the operational status of the Chemical Agent Monitor (CAM). It includes the necessary simulated sources and electronic diagnostics to ensure chemical warning devices are accurately detecting threats.

NAME: AN/USQ-152 Radiac Deployment Kit
DESCRIPTION: This kit contains a standardized assortment of radiation detection, measuring, and personal dosimetry equipment for deploying units. It equips a tactical element with everything needed to monitor radiation levels and ensure personnel safety in a contaminated environment.

NAME: KIV-7M Encryption-Decryption Device
DESCRIPTION: The KIV-7M is a cryptographic device that encrypts and decrypts classified military communications over various networks. It provides high-speed, secure data tunneling to protect sensitive voice, video, and data transmissions from enemy interception.

NAME: CYPRES 2 Automatic Activation Device
DESCRIPTION: This is a critical safety device attached to a paratrooper's reserve parachute system. It uses altitude and descent rate sensors to automatically deploy the reserve parachute if the jumper is falling too fast at a dangerously low altitude.

NAME: 120,000-Gallon Fuel System Supply Point (FSSP)
DESCRIPTION: This is a massive, deployable tactical fuel storage and distribution system consisting of collapsible fabric tanks, hoses, and pumps. It can store up to 120,000 gallons of bulk fuel, serving as a primary refueling hub for combat vehicles and aircraft in the theater of operations.

NAME: 300,000-Gallon Fuel System Supply Point (FSSP)
DESCRIPTION: This is the Army's largest standardized tactical fuel farm, utilizing multiple large collapsible bladders to store up to 300,000 gallons of fuel. It is established at major logistical bases to support heavy mechanized forces and aviation brigades during sustained combat operations.

NAME: 200-Pound Capacity Roller Conveyor
DESCRIPTION: This is a section of gravity-fed roller track used in warehouses and cargo handling areas to move moderately heavy boxes and supplies. It reduces the physical strain on logistics personnel when loading and unloading cargo from transport vehicles.

NAME: 1,000-Pound Capacity Roller Conveyor
DESCRIPTION: This is a heavy-duty section of roller track designed to move large, heavy pallets and containers weighing up to 1,000 pounds. It is frequently used at distribution hubs and aerial ports to rapidly shift heavy munitions and equipment.

NAME: 16-Foot Airdrop Platform Coupling
DESCRIPTION: This hardware component is used to securely connect and assemble sections of modular airdrop platforms to a length of 16 feet. It ensures the platform remains structurally sound when dropped from a cargo aircraft with heavy equipment loaded on it.

NAME: 20-Foot Airdrop Platform Coupling
DESCRIPTION: This structural coupling hardware connects sections of modular airdrop platforms to achieve a 20-foot total length. It provides the necessary rigidity for the platform to survive the stress of aerial extraction and ground impact.

NAME: 24-Foot Airdrop Platform Coupling
DESCRIPTION: This heavy-duty coupling links modular airdrop platform segments together to form a large 24-foot base. It is essential for rigging exceptionally large items, such as tactical vehicles or artillery pieces, for parachute drops.

NAME: M149A2 Water Trailer System
DESCRIPTION: Often referred to as a "Water Buffalo," this is a trailer-mounted 400-gallon water tank used to transport and distribute potable water to troops in the field. It can be towed by medium tactical vehicles and features spigots for soldiers to quickly fill their canteens.

NAME: Fifth Wheel Towing Assembly
DESCRIPTION: This is a heavy-duty coupling mechanism mounted onto the rear of a tractor truck to attach and tow semi-trailers. It bears the weight of the trailer's front end and allows for articulation during turns on rough tactical routes.

NAME: MEP-802A 5kW Tactical Quiet Generator
DESCRIPTION: The MEP-802A is a rugged, diesel-powered generator that provides 5 kilowatts of reliable electrical power in field environments. It is acoustically suppressed to reduce noise and is used to power small command posts, communications gear, and medical equipment.

NAME: MEP-806A 60kW Tactical Quiet Generator
DESCRIPTION: This is a heavy-duty, diesel-driven generator capable of providing 60 kilowatts of electrical power for large tactical operations. It is used to power major command and control centers, large weapon systems, and expansive field hospitals.

NAME: MEP-1040 15kW Advanced Medium Mobile Power Source (AMMPS)
DESCRIPTION: This is a modern, fuel-efficient 15-kilowatt diesel generator from the AMMPS family, designed to replace older tactical quiet generators. It provides cleaner, more reliable power for expeditionary forces while consuming significantly less fuel.

NAME: AN/ASM-189 Electronic Shop Shelter
DESCRIPTION: This is a mobile, shelter-mounted electronics repair facility used by military maintenance technicians. It houses specialized diagnostic equipment and workbenches, allowing personnel to repair complex aviation or ground electronic components in a tactical environment.

NAME: Advanced Aviation Forward Area Refueling Engine (A-AFARE)
DESCRIPTION: The Forward Area Refueling system is a highly mobile, pump-driven fuel transfer asset used to quickly refuel helicopters and vehicles close to the front lines. It draws fuel from collapsible drums or bladders and pushes it through hoses to the aircraft, enabling rapid turnaround times.

NAME: Joint Precision Airdrop System (JPADS)
DESCRIPTION: The JPADS is an autonomous, GPS-guided parachute system that steers cargo bundles to a specific geographic coordinate on the ground. It allows transport aircraft to safely drop vital supplies from high altitudes, keeping the plane out of range of enemy air defenses while ensuring accurate delivery.

NAME: A-22 Cargo Aerial Delivery Bag
DESCRIPTION: This is a durable, adjustable cargo sling bag used for dropping standard bundles of supplies from military aircraft. It safely secures critical ammunition, rations, and equipment to a cargo parachute for rapid resupply to ground forces.

NAME: Tactical Local Area Network (TACLAN)
DESCRIPTION: This is a deployable suite of servers, routers, and network switches used to establish secure computer networks in a field command post. It allows commanders and staff to access classified and unclassified data, email, and battle tracking software in austere environments.

NAME: Mobile Kitchen Trailer (MKT)
DESCRIPTION: The Mobile Kitchen Trailer is a towable, rapidly deployable field kitchen used by Army food service specialists to prepare and serve hot meals to troops. It features diesel-fired burners, ovens, and prep spaces, capable of feeding hundreds of soldiers daily in a tactical environment.

NAME: MEP-803A 10kW Tactical Quiet Generator
DESCRIPTION: The MEP-803A is a standard military diesel generator that provides 10 kilowatts of continuous electrical power. It is heavily utilized across the force to power tactical operations centers, sophisticated communications arrays, and environmental control units.

NAME: MK-2512/PDR-75 Maintenance Kit
DESCRIPTION: This is a specialized maintenance kit containing tools and parts required to repair and calibrate the AN/PDR-75 individual radiation dosimeter system. It allows field technicians to maintain the equipment that monitors personal radiation exposure for troops.

NAME: RA-1 Advanced RAM Air Parachute System
DESCRIPTION: The RA-1 is a high-performance, steerable ram-air parachute system used primarily by Special Operations Forces for military freefall jumps. It allows operators to jump from high altitudes and glide silently over long distances to infiltrate enemy territory undetected.

NAME: M1224 MaxxPro Mine Resistant Ambush Protected (MRAP) Vehicle
DESCRIPTION: The MaxxPro is a heavily armored tactical vehicle designed with a V-shaped hull to deflect the blasts from improvised explosive devices (IEDs) and landmines. It is used to safely transport troops and conduct patrols in highly threatening, asymmetric combat environments.

NAME: M1230 Caiman Mine Resistant Ambush Protected (MRAP) Vehicle
DESCRIPTION: The Caiman is a variant of the MRAP family, providing exceptional crew protection against underbody blasts, IEDs, and small arms fire. It offers a large interior volume for troops or medical evacuation while maintaining high mobility in urban and off-road environments.

NAME: 600 GPM Centrifugal Pumping Unit
DESCRIPTION: This is a heavy-duty, engine-driven centrifugal pump used by quartermaster pipeline companies to move massive volumes of bulk fuel or water over long distances. Capable of pumping 600 gallons per minute, it is a critical node in theater-level fluid logistics.

NAME: M160 Robotic Mine Flail
DESCRIPTION: The M160 is a remote-controlled, tracked ground vehicle equipped with a heavy rotating flail to safely detonate and clear anti-personnel mines. It allows combat engineers to breach minefields from a safe distance without exposing human operators to explosive hazards.

NAME: Medium Unmanned Ground Vehicle
DESCRIPTION: This is a medium-sized remote-controlled ground robot primarily used by Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) and engineer teams. It features tracks and a highly articulate manipulator arm, allowing operators to remotely inspect and disarm improvised explosive devices.

NAME: General Mechanics Tool Kit (GMTK)
DESCRIPTION: The GMTK is a comprehensive, portable toolset issued to Army mechanics for performing field-level maintenance on military vehicles and equipment. It contains a standard assortment of heavy-duty wrenches, sockets, and pliers packaged in a durable, multi-drawer case.

NAME: M978 Tank and Pump Unit (TPU)
DESCRIPTION: The Tank and Pump Unit consists of fuel tanks and a pumping assembly that can be mounted in the bed of a standard tactical cargo truck. It transforms a normal cargo vehicle into a mobile refueling asset to support forward-deployed elements.

NAME: 28-Foot Cargo Extraction Parachute
DESCRIPTION: This 28-foot diameter parachute is primarily used to extract heavy cargo platforms from the rear of a moving transport aircraft during flight. As it inflates in the aircraft's slipstream, it pulls the payload safely out of the cargo ramp to begin its descent.

NAME: 28-Foot Cargo Parachute
DESCRIPTION: This durable cargo parachute is utilized to stabilize and drop moderate-weight equipment bundles from military transport planes. It ensures that resupply pallets land intact and in the designated drop zone.

NAME: 26-Foot Ringslot Cargo Parachute
DESCRIPTION: This specialized parachute features a ringslot canopy design that allows some air to pass through it, providing extreme stability during high-speed deployments. It is typically used as a drogue or extraction parachute for dragging heavy equipment out of the aircraft.

NAME: M1135 Stryker Nuclear, Biological, Chemical Reconnaissance Vehicle (NBCRV)
DESCRIPTION: The M1135 is an eight-wheeled armored Stryker vehicle equipped with a specialized sensor suite to detect chemical, biological, and radiological threats on the battlefield. Its pressurized cabin allows a specialized crew to safely sample the environment without wearing cumbersome protective suits.

NAME: G-14 Cargo Parachute
DESCRIPTION: The G-14 is a standard cargo parachute utilized for dropping smaller logistical bundles, typically up to 500 pounds. It is commonly attached to A-22 or A-21 cargo bags for the aerial delivery of rations, water, and ammunition.

NAME: 15-Foot Cargo Extraction Parachute
DESCRIPTION: This small, incredibly robust parachute is deployed directly behind a transport aircraft in flight to physically pull multi-ton pallets out of the cargo bay. It initiates the airdrop sequence before the main descent parachutes take over.

NAME: G-12E Cargo Parachute
DESCRIPTION: The G-12 series cargo parachute is a massive 64-foot canopy designed to safely deliver heavy pallets and vehicles to the ground. Multiple G-12s are often clustered together to drop loads weighing several thousands of pounds.

NAME: Petroleum Quality Analysis System (PQAS)
DESCRIPTION: This is a mobile, shelter-mounted laboratory used by specialized petroleum supply units to test and verify the purity and grade of bulk fuels in the field. It ensures that fuel supplies are free of water and contaminants before being pumped into sensitive aircraft and combat vehicles.

NAME: AN/MJQ-40B Tactical Power Plant
DESCRIPTION: This is a trailer-mounted dual-generator system that provides redundant, high-reliability electrical power to mission-critical command and control systems. The two generators work in tandem to ensure that if one fails, the other immediately assumes the electrical load without interrupting operations.

NAME: G-12 Cargo Parachute
DESCRIPTION: Measuring 64 feet in diameter, this heavy-duty canopy is the Army's workhorse for delivering large vehicles, artillery, and massive supply pallets from the air. By clustering several of these parachutes together, riggers can safely drop tens of thousands of pounds of equipment in a single pass.

NAME: 15-Foot Cargo Extraction Parachute
DESCRIPTION: Designed for the initial stage of heavy airdrops, this parachute deploys behind the aircraft to act as a massive drag chute. The force of the air pulling against it extracts the heavy cargo platform off the aircraft ramp and into the sky.

NAME: 22-Foot Cargo Extraction Parachute
DESCRIPTION: Similar to the 15-foot variant, this larger 22-foot extraction parachute is used to drag exceptionally heavy equipment platforms out of the aircraft cargo bay. It produces enough drag to quickly pull multi-ton armored vehicles safely out of the flying plane.

NAME: Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Tool Kit
DESCRIPTION: This is a specialized, portable set of tools, gauges, and hoses used by quartermaster mechanics to repair environmental control units and field refrigeration systems. It contains the equipment necessary to handle refrigerants, test pressures, and fix vital food and medical cooling equipment in the field.

NAME: Specialized Vehicular Tool Kit
DESCRIPTION: This is an advanced maintenance tool kit issued to specialized mechanics, containing pullers, diagnostic tools, and gauges not found in standard general mechanic sets. It allows maintenance personnel to conduct deep, complex repairs on heavy tactical vehicle transmissions, engines, and suspensions.

NAME: RT240 Rough Terrain Container Handler (RTCH)
DESCRIPTION: Affectionately known as the "RTCH" (Reach), this is a massive, highly maneuverable forklift capable of lifting and stacking standard 20-foot and 40-foot shipping containers weighing up to 53,000 pounds. It features oversized tires and heavy suspension, allowing it to operate in unimproved mud or sand environments at field supply yards.

NAME: AN/URM-213 Radio Frequency Power Test Set
DESCRIPTION: This electronic testing suite is used by communications repair personnel to measure and verify the signal output power of military radios and antennas. By ensuring radios are broadcasting at correct power levels, it guarantees reliable, long-distance communication links for battlefield units.

NAME: AN/PRM-34 Radio Test Set
DESCRIPTION: The AN/PRM-34 is a portable, ruggedized diagnostic instrument used to troubleshoot tactical field radios down to the component level. It provides signal generation and measuring capabilities to identify and fix faults in military communications gear.

NAME: Type V 12-Foot Airdrop Platform Side Rail
DESCRIPTION: This is a heavy aluminum structural component used to construct the framework of a 12-foot Type V airdrop platform. It provides the required rigidity and tie-down points to secure large equipment for parachute delivery.

NAME: Type V 32-Foot Airdrop Platform Side Rail
DESCRIPTION: This extreme-length structural rail is used by parachute riggers to build massive 32-foot long platforms for the heaviest airdrops. It ensures the platform doesn't flex or break when supporting heavy construction equipment or armored vehicles dropping from an aircraft.

NAME: Type V 16-Foot Airdrop Platform Side Rail
DESCRIPTION: This aluminum rail component is an essential building block for creating a 16-foot Type V heavy airdrop platform. It holds the modular floor panels together and anchors the cargo straps during the violent shock of parachute deployment.

NAME: Type V 8-Foot Airdrop Platform Side Rail
DESCRIPTION: This is a shorter structural rail segment used to construct small 8-foot airdrop platforms or to extend the length of larger modular setups. It provides a durable frame for dropping relatively light tactical equipment and supply pallets.

NAME: M870A3 Low Bed Semitrailer
DESCRIPTION: The M870 series is a heavy-duty, flatbed gooseneck trailer utilized primarily by engineer units to transport heavy tracked bulldozers, excavators, and construction equipment. Its low deck height makes loading heavy machinery easier and keeps the center of gravity low during transport over rough roads.

NAME: 34-Ton Commercial Flatbed Trailer
DESCRIPTION: This is a militarized commercial-style flatbed trailer designed to haul up to 34 tons of palletized cargo, shipping containers, or building materials on paved roads. It is typically towed by military line-haul truck tractors to sustain long-distance logistical supply chains.

NAME: M969A2 5,000-Gallon Fuel Semitrailer
DESCRIPTION: This is a bulk fuel hauling trailer capable of transporting 5,000 gallons of diesel or aviation fuel to tactical supply points. It features an onboard engine-driven pumping assembly, allowing it to rapidly transfer fuel to other vehicles or storage bladders.

NAME: 18-Gauge Metal Shears
DESCRIPTION: This is a heavy-duty shop tool used by allied trades specialists and machinists to cut sheet metal up to an 18-gauge thickness. It is an essential component of metalworking shops for fabricating custom repair parts or welding patches in the field.

NAME: Type V 20-Foot Airdrop Platform Side Rail
DESCRIPTION: This load-bearing aluminum rail is utilized to assemble 20-foot long heavy airdrop platforms. It secures the platform's interlocking floor panels and provides anchor points to lock the platform securely onto the transport aircraft's cargo rail system.

NAME: Type V 24-Foot Airdrop Platform Side Rail
DESCRIPTION: This lengthy structural component forms the outer framework for 24-foot modular parachute drop platforms. It is built to withstand extreme mechanical stress, protecting the heavy cargo load as it extracts from the plane and strikes the drop zone.

NAME: Type V 28-Foot Airdrop Platform Side Rail
DESCRIPTION: This massive aluminum side rail is combined with other modular segments to assemble a 28-foot heavy drop platform. It is vital for maintaining the structural integrity of extremely long or heavy cargo drops, such as bridging equipment or large tactical trucks.

NAME: D7R II Full-Tracked Bulldozer
DESCRIPTION: This is a massive, heavily armored, tracked bulldozer employed by combat engineers for earthmoving, runway construction, and clearing battlefield obstacles. It provides unparalleled pushing power and crew protection when carving out combat roads under hostile conditions.

NAME: Secondary Transfer Calibration Set
DESCRIPTION: This is a standardized suite of highly sensitive electronic testing equipment utilized by calibration specialists. It allows technicians to verify and adjust tactical maintenance tools, ensuring that field repairs are performed to exact technical tolerances.

NAME: Secondary Transfer Calibration Set
DESCRIPTION: Similar to other sets under this designation, it is a collection of master reference tools and gauges used to calibrate the Army's field-level test, measurement, and diagnostic equipment. It guarantees the accuracy of sensitive repairs across the force.

NAME: M1097A2 Heavy Variant High Mobility Multipurpose Wheeled Vehicle (HMMWV)
DESCRIPTION: The M1097 is a heavy payload variant of the classic HMMWV, featuring an upgraded suspension and drivetrain to carry heavy cargo, shelters, or troop carriers. It serves as a rugged, all-terrain utility truck for almost every type of combat and support unit.

NAME: Reverse Osmosis Water Purification Unit (ROWPU)
DESCRIPTION: The ROWPU is a highly sophisticated, deployable water treatment plant capable of turning muddy, brackish, or chemically contaminated water into potable drinking water. It uses advanced multi-stage filtration and reverse osmosis membranes to supply clean water for an entire deployed task force.

NAME: M1093 Medium Tactical Vehicle (MTV) Standard Cargo Truck
DESCRIPTION: The M1093 is a 5-ton, 6x6 tactical cargo truck designed for airdrop operations, falling under the Family of Medium Tactical Vehicles (FMTV). It is an incredibly capable off-road transport used to move troops, ammunition, and heavy pallets across the battlefield.

NAME: M1081A1 Light Medium Tactical Vehicle (LMTV) Airborne Cargo Truck
DESCRIPTION: The M1081 is a 2.5-ton, 4x4 tactical cargo truck specifically rigged with folding cab components to allow it to be airdropped from transport aircraft. It provides immediate tactical mobility and logistics support to airborne infantry units upon landing in a drop zone.

NAME: M989A1 Heavy Expanded Mobility Ammunition Trailer (HEMAT)
DESCRIPTION: The HEMAT is a rugged, heavy-duty trailer specifically designed to transport heavy rockets, artillery shells, and guided missile pods over extremely rough terrain. It is primarily towed by HEMTT trucks to resupply forward-deployed Multiple Launch Rocket Systems (MLRS) and artillery batteries.

NAME: 4,000-Pound Diesel Forklift (Model DV43)
DESCRIPTION: This is a compact, diesel-powered forklift used in field warehouses, supply rooms, and motor pools. With a lifting capacity of 4,000 pounds, it is vital for efficiently moving palletized rations, repair parts, and small equipment loads in tight spaces.

NAME: M4K 4,000-Pound Rough Terrain Forklift
DESCRIPTION: The M4K is a militarized, heavy-duty forklift equipped with large pneumatic tires and four-wheel drive to operate in mud, sand, and unimproved terrain. It is essential for loading and unloading cargo trucks in austere tactical environments where paved surfaces do not exist.

NAME: M977A2 Heavy Expanded Mobility Tactical Truck (HEMTT) Cargo
DESCRIPTION: The M977 HEMTT is a massive 8x8 heavy tactical truck used to transport large quantities of ammunition, fuel, or logistical pallets across rugged terrain. It is equipped with a rear-mounted material handling crane to self-load and unload heavy cargo without the need for a separate forklift.

NAME: M1078A1 Light Medium Tactical Vehicle (LMTV) Cargo Truck
DESCRIPTION: The M1078 is the standard 2.5-ton, 4x4 utility and cargo truck in the Army's FMTV fleet. It serves as the primary all-terrain troop and light supply transport, known for its reliability and excellent off-road mobility.

NAME: M1088A1 Medium Tactical Vehicle (MTV) Tractor
DESCRIPTION: The M1088 is a 5-ton, 6x6 tractor truck variant of the FMTV, equipped with a fifth wheel for towing medium semitrailers over rough tactical routes. It is heavily utilized by logistics units to transport flatbeds and fuel trailers to forward positions.

NAME: M1088A1 Medium Tactical Vehicle (MTV) Tractor with Winch
DESCRIPTION: This is the same 5-ton tactical tractor truck as the standard M1088, but equipped with a heavy-duty, frame-mounted recovery winch. The winch allows the crew to self-recover if the truck gets stuck in deep mud or to assist in recovering other light vehicles.

NAME: M1113 Expanded Capacity High Mobility Multipurpose Wheeled Vehicle (HMMWV)
DESCRIPTION: The M1113 is an upgraded HMMWV variant featuring a significantly beefed-up chassis and suspension to support specialized, heavy shelter systems. It is primarily used as the carrier for mobile command posts, heavy communications arrays, and specialized medical shelters.

NAME: M1083A1 Medium Tactical Vehicle (MTV) Cargo Truck
DESCRIPTION: The M1083 is the standard 5-ton, 6x6 cargo truck of the FMTV family, used universally for transporting troops, supplies, and towing medium artillery pieces. Its cab-over-engine design provides excellent visibility, and it boasts outstanding cross-country performance.

NAME: M984A4 Heavy Expanded Mobility Tactical Truck (HEMTT) Wrecker
DESCRIPTION: The M984 is a massive 8x8 heavy recovery vehicle equipped with a heavy-duty material handling crane, a heavy drag winch, and a rear lift-and-tow system. It is the Army's premier tactical wrecker, capable of pulling disabled 10-ton vehicles out of mud or towing damaged trucks off the battlefield.

NAME: 20-Foot Top Handler
DESCRIPTION: This is a heavy structural attachment fitted to massive field forklifts, such as the RTCH, that allows them to grasp 20-foot shipping containers from the top corner castings. It makes stacking and sorting massive steel containers rapid and secure.

NAME: 40-Foot Top Handler
DESCRIPTION: Similar to the 20-foot version, this incredibly wide lifting attachment allows heavy container handlers to safely grab and manipulate massive 40-foot shipping containers. It is essential for operating high-throughput strategic aerial ports and railheads.

NAME: M1074A1 Palletized Load System (PLS) Truck
DESCRIPTION: The PLS is a colossal 10x10 tactical logistics truck featuring an integrated hydraulic load handling system that can rapidly pull flatracks loaded with cargo onto its back. It is designed to quickly transport large amounts of artillery ammunition or supplies over rough terrain, dropping them off and driving away in seconds.

NAME: M978A2 Heavy Expanded Mobility Tactical Truck (HEMTT) Fuel Servicing Truck
DESCRIPTION: The M978 is a heavily armored 8x8 tactical tanker truck capable of carrying 2,500 gallons of fuel over the most unforgiving terrain. It serves as a mobile gas station, pushing fuel as far forward as possible to sustain armored and aviation formations in combat.

NAME: M915A5 Line Haul Tractor Truck
DESCRIPTION: The M915 is a militarized, heavy-duty commercial truck tractor utilized for long-distance highway hauling of bulk supplies and shipping containers. While not intended for deep off-road tactical use, it is the backbone of theater-level supply chains along paved and improved supply routes.

NAME: T-11 Personnel Parachute System
DESCRIPTION: The T-11 is the Army's modern non-steerable mass-tactical personnel parachute, replacing the legacy T-10. It features a unique, square-shaped canopy that drastically reduces the rate of descent and landing oscillation, resulting in fewer jump injuries for paratroopers.

NAME: M1089A1 Medium Tactical Vehicle (MTV) Wrecker
DESCRIPTION: The M1089 is the wrecker variant of the 5-ton FMTV, equipped with a material handling crane and powerful winches. It is used by unit mechanics to recover light and medium wheeled vehicles that have become stuck, disabled, or damaged in the field.

NAME: M1120A4 Heavy Expanded Mobility Tactical Truck (HEMTT) Load Handling System (LHS)
DESCRIPTION: Similar to the PLS, the HEMTT LHS is an 8x8 heavy truck featuring a hydraulic hook-arm system that can rapidly pull loaded cargo flatracks onto its bed. It drastically reduces loading and unloading times, making logistical convoys much more efficient and less vulnerable.

NAME: Parachute Inspection Table (8x3 Foot)
DESCRIPTION: This is a long, smooth, specially designed work table used by parachute riggers to inspect, layout, and pack personnel and cargo parachutes. Its smooth surface ensures that delicate parachute silk and suspension lines do not snag or tear during the critical repacking process.

NAME: 96-Inch Parachute Packing Table Section
DESCRIPTION: This is a modular, high-quality packing table section used in military rigging facilities. Several of these sections are pushed together to create massive continuous surfaces necessary to lay out and pack exceptionally large cargo parachutes.

NAME: 126-Gallon Tank and Pump Unit
DESCRIPTION: This is a compact, self-contained fluid tank and pump system designed to be mounted on smaller tactical vehicles or trailers. It provides mobile, small-scale dispensing of water or specialized fluids to remote teams.

NAME: Liquid Dispensing Tank Unit
DESCRIPTION: This is a generic tactical tank and dispensing assembly used to store and pump water, fuel, or de-icing fluids in motor pools and field locations. It includes the storage vessel, hoses, and nozzles necessary for controlled fluid distribution.

NAME: Tactical Water Purification System (TWPS)
DESCRIPTION: The TWPS is a highly mobile, state-of-the-art water purification plant capable of treating 1,500 gallons of water per hour from freshwater sources, or 1,200 gallons from seawater or NBC-contaminated sources. It ensures ground troops have a massive, continuous supply of clean drinking water in any environment.

NAME: Canvas Worker Tool Kit
DESCRIPTION: This specialized kit contains heavy-duty needles, industrial thread, grommets, and cutting tools. It is used by quartermaster personnel and parachute riggers to repair torn tactical tents, vehicle canvas covers, and heavy nylon webbing.

NAME: Water Storage and Distribution System (WSDS)
DESCRIPTION: This system consists of large capacity collapsible fabric bladders, pumps, and hoses used to store and distribute thousands of gallons of purified water in a forward operating base. It serves as the primary drinking water reservoir for sustained, large-scale field operations.

NAME: D7H Full-Tracked Low Speed Tractor
DESCRIPTION: The D7H is an earlier model of the heavy tracked bulldozer utilized by engineer units for major earthmoving tasks. It features immense torque and traction to push dirt, carve out defensive berms, and grade combat airstrips.

NAME: Horizontal Construction Engineer
DESCRIPTION: A 12N operates heavy construction machinery such as bulldozers, scrapers, and graders to shape the terrain. They are responsible for building combat roads, leveling ground for forward operating bases, and digging massive defensive fighting positions.

NAME: Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear (CBRN) Warrant Officer
DESCRIPTION: A 740 serves as the primary technical advisor to commanders regarding hazardous materials, WMDs, and CBRN defense. They plan, coordinate, and supervise unit decontamination procedures and advise on surviving and operating in contaminated environments.

NAME: Transportation Senior Sergeant
DESCRIPTION: An 88Z is the highest-level enlisted subject matter expert in Army transportation and logistics. They manage massive theater-level movements of troops, cargo, and equipment by coordinating convoy operations, rail nodes, and aerial ports.

NAME: Construction Equipment Repairer
DESCRIPTION: A 91L specializes in troubleshooting and repairing the Army's fleet of heavy construction machinery, including bulldozers, graders, and cranes. They perform deep mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical maintenance to keep engineer equipment fully operational.

NAME: Airdrop Systems Technician
DESCRIPTION: A 921 is a highly specialized warrant officer who manages and oversees all parachute rigging and aerial delivery operations. They ensure that complex cargo loads are properly rigged to survive being dropped from transport aircraft and safely reach ground troops.

NAME: Food Service Technician
DESCRIPTION: A 922 is a warrant officer who serves as the commander's primary advisor on all matters relating to culinary operations and field feeding. They manage garrison dining facilities, deployable field kitchens, and massive logistical food supply chains to sustain unit morale and nutrition.

NAME: Petroleum Systems Technician
DESCRIPTION: A 923 is a technical expert warrant officer in charge of bulk fuel operations and storage. They manage massive tactical fuel farms, coordinate pipeline distribution, and ensure stringent petroleum quality testing is conducted to protect expensive vehicle and aviation engines.

NAME: Petroleum Laboratory Specialist
DESCRIPTION: A 92L operates specialized mobile laboratories to test and evaluate the physical and chemical properties of military fuels and lubricants. They ensure that fuel supplies are free of water and contaminants before being pumped into sensitive combat aircraft and vehicles.

NAME: Parachute Rigger
DESCRIPTION: A 92R is responsible for inspecting, repairing, and meticulously packing personnel and heavy cargo parachutes. Their exacting work ensures that paratroopers land safely and that heavy vehicles and supplies survive violent airborne insertions.

NAME: Test Measurement and Diagnostic Equipment (TMDE) Maintenance Support Specialist
DESCRIPTION: A 94H operates high-precision mobile calibration laboratories to test and align the Army's electronic, physical, and mechanical diagnostic tools. They ensure all field-level maintenance equipment is accurate, preventing faulty tools from causing weapon system failures.

NAME: Commercial 16-Passenger Van
DESCRIPTION: This is a commercial-off-the-shelf passenger van capable of transporting up to 16 personnel. It is used by military units for administrative transportation, troop shuttling, and routine logistics on paved roads in non-tactical environments.

NAME: M40 Field Protective Mask
DESCRIPTION: The M40 is a standard-issue chemical and biological protective mask designed to protect the wearer from field concentrations of chemical and biological agents, as well as radiological fallout particles. It features a silicone rubber facepiece and uses a screw-on NATO standard filter canister.

NAME: AN/PVS-7 Night Vision Goggles
DESCRIPTION: The AN/PVS-7 is a single-tube, bi-ocular night vision goggle system used by military personnel for nighttime operations. It amplifies ambient light, such as starlight or moonlight, to allow soldiers to navigate, drive, and conduct missions in extreme low-light conditions.

NAME: M9 9mm Pistol
DESCRIPTION: The M9 is a 9mm semi-automatic pistol traditionally utilized as a standard-issue personal defense weapon. It features a 15-round staggered magazine and is primarily issued to officers, vehicle crews, and personnel who cannot practically carry a full-sized rifle during their duties.

NAME: M16A2 5.56mm Rifle
DESCRIPTION: The M16A2 is a lightweight, air-cooled, gas-operated, shoulder-fired 5.56mm assault rifle. It is designed for either semi-automatic fire or three-round burst, serving as a reliable infantry weapon capable of engaging point targets up to 550 meters away.

NAME: M500 12-Gauge Shotgun
DESCRIPTION: The M500 is a military-issue 12-gauge pump-action shotgun used primarily for close-quarters combat, door breaching, and guard duty. It provides immense short-range stopping power and can fire a variety of ammunition types, including buckshot, slugs, and non-lethal rounds.

NAME: Commercial Compact Cargo Truck
DESCRIPTION: This is a commercial-off-the-shelf compact cargo truck or light pickup utilized for general base operations. It provides light logistical support and equipment transport in non-tactical, garrison environments where heavy military tactical vehicles are unnecessary.

NAME: Commercial 1-Ton Cargo Truck
DESCRIPTION: This is a commercial 1-ton pickup truck or utility vehicle with a gross vehicle weight rating of up to 10,000 pounds. It is typically used for on-post utility work, transporting small teams, and moving light supplies along paved routes in garrison locations.

NAME: Commercial 1.5-Ton Cargo Truck
DESCRIPTION: This is a commercial cab-and-chassis cargo truck rated at 1.5 tons with an 8,500-pound gross vehicle weight. It is utilized by garrison and support units for routine hauling, mail delivery, or light material transport in benign, non-tactical environments.

NAME: Commercial 1.5-Ton Stake Truck
DESCRIPTION: This is a commercial 1.5-ton stakebed truck with a 10,000-pound gross vehicle weight rating. The removable side stakes allow personnel to efficiently load, transport, and unload bulky materials, wooden pallets, and large equipment across military installations.

NAME: Military Police Officer
